integrity: An all-parameter bijective proof is given, and independent exact finite algorithms agree on every signed chain coefficient for graph sizes 1 through 9; this is not an independently audited result.
scientific_limitations: The graded signed cellular trace determines the rational reduced Lefschetz number and quotient Euler characteristic, but not individual-degree homology representations, torsion, or quotient homotopy types.
title: Reversal-twisted Lefschetz series of half-graph matching complexes
